original_benchmark.notes: 98 cases (java 53, cpp 15, go 13, python 13, nodejs 4) x 4 scenarios (gen, gen-hints, fix, fix-hints). Upstream E2E mode drives IDE/CLI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code); exact supported agent versions not pinned upstream. 8 Java cases use an LLM-judge tester.

harbor_adapter.notes: WORK IN PROGRESS: Python (12 cases), Node.js (4) and C/C++ (14) ported, x 4 scenarios = 120 tasks, oracle 120/120. Excluded as broken upstream: python/SQLInjectionSQLite3, cpp/BufferOverflowMemset (--include-broken). 8 Java LLM-judge cases excluded by default (--include-llm-judge). Go/Java pending. No parity yet.
